scope: Additive Mighty Yak L1-15 level and current wall-target behavior audit; no paired-Pet combat actor is enabled.
game_version: Official behavior notes through 2026-04-27; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba; current 18.600.3 values and AI contract unverified.

sources.title: Meet The Hero Pets!
sources.levels: Pet House 3 onward; no numerical Pet level table
facts: Favorite target was within seven tiles of assigned Hero; targets ground and deals extra damage to Walls; published movement speed was 24 and damage type was area splash at introduction.
sources.limitations: The movement speed conflicts with the pinned raw record's 20. The area-splash claim was explicitly superseded in September 2021. This article gives no wall multiplier or targeting tick order.

sources.title: Summer Update Full Notes
facts: A Yak helping its Hero destroy a Wall must retarget if the Hero is knocked out or targets something else.
sources.limitations: The note does not define how the Yak chooses a new target or which 10 ms tick resolves a simultaneous Hero target change.

sources.title: New Levels & Balance Changes!
facts: Splash damage was removed from the Mighty Yak's attacks.
sources.limitations: No new radius, hit timing or wall behavior was published.

sources.title: Full Patch Notes
facts: L11-15 HP are 5700, 5850, 6000, 6150, 6300 and DPS are 100, 104, 108, 112, 116, matching the pinned raw table.
sources.limitations: The table does not prove values are unchanged in the current TH18 build or publish wall damage.

sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
facts: A Yak AI bug that made it too hesitant to attack Walls sometimes was fixed.
sources.limitations: The updated wall-selection predicate, radius and tick ordering were not published.

sources.title: Pinned Mighty Yak Home Village Pet record
facts: Each level has damageVsWalls equal to 20 times damagePerHit; the record also claims a rage on companion knockout and movement speed 20.
sources.limitations: The payload does not identify current client build, rage event order, effect stacking or updated wall selection after the 2026 AI fix.

derivations.method: Lossless normalization of per-level values from the pinned raw payload. The 20 times ratio is verified but is not used as a dynamic Core multiplier.

derivations.result: Pin official HP and DPS values independently of raw
derivations.method: Exact 2023 Supercell level table; matching raw values get primary-source field provenance.

rejected_inferences.rule: Use the 2021 area-splash attack in current Core
rejected_inferences.reason: Supercell explicitly removed splash damage in September 2021.
The introduction and pinned payload disagree, and no current-build resolution was found.

rejected_inferences.rule: Implement a twentyfold Wall multiplier and eight-second post-Hero-death rage as current behavior
rejected_inferences.reason: Only an older build-unidentified payload gives the numbers; the 2026 wall AI fix gives no deterministic target-selection contract.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply current wall retargeting on a guessed fixed-tick phase
rejected_inferences.reason: Official notes define a transition trigger but omit target choice and simultaneous-event ordering.

items: Hero-linked spawn, follow and knockout event order
post-2026 wall selection and seven-tile preference semantics
collision geometry, anchors and battlefield art rights

conclusion: Mighty Yak L1-15 remains partial and catalogue-only. Its pinned wall-damage field and official L11-15 HP and DPS are preserved; superseded splash and incomplete wall AI or rage rules do not enable a faithful Core actor.
